set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 0 item 7, §5 item 7.

Main is about 75 commits ahead of origin; everything exists only on this machine. The first CI run hit an Actions billing block, which the owner deferred (the CI bead bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX).

Scope:
Two owner actions: push, and a CI route (billing, public repository, or self-hosted runner).

Acceptance criteria:
1. main is pushed; `git rev-list --count origin/main..main` returns 0 at the time of the note.
2. A CI route is chosen and recorded on this bead and on the CI bead.

Gate: the owner's decision is recorded verbatim, or faithfully summarized and confirmed by the
owner, as a decision note on this bead.

Size: S (owner).
set.title: OWNER: push main to origin (about 75 local commits) and choose a CI route
